notes.title: AEROMACHINA: Test-Flight – Hotfix (ver. 0.1.0.1)
notes.notes: [p]Hi everybody, and thank you for the day one love! We hope you've been enjoying your time with Bogey's Test-Flight thus far. [/p][p]Your feedback has been great to see - and we've been working hard today to sort out the biggest issues we've seen reported thus far.[/p][p][/p][h2]Hotfix (ver. 0.1.1)[/h2][p][/p][p]- Some issues regarding unlock permanence on death should be resolved[/p][p]- The mysterious ghost crates in Storage Room A have been exorcised[/p][p]- A couple of false dialogue triggers have been fixed[/p][p]- The endgame sidequest now has improved breadcrumbing[/p][p]- Performance in Caret's death spinner room has been improved[/p][p]- Fixed a rare issue where the Vulcan Gun would not function correctly[/p][p]- Can no longer out of bounds in the Armoury[/p]
